items.title: Thor
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Play an epic adventure with Thor. Be the controller of thunder and the king of Asgard.

- Thor
- 15 skins

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Pirates
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Looking for an epic pirate adventure? Take all your friends with you as you conquer the secret dungeon of the pirate fortress. Dress up as a brave pirate while you search the island for treasures or explore the shipwreck and village.

- 3 skins
- Roleplay 
- Dungeon 
- Hidden treasures 

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Orc Camp
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Orc Camp is a dark place only for the best orcs on this planet. Join with your friends and have fun with roleplaying.

- Orc camp
- Mine
- Roleplay

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Glitch Demons 2
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
Glitch Demons are naughty and nice! They hack and troll because they love to cause mischief and are very good at it! Become a demon today and roleplay with your friends as colorful rainbow glitches!

- 11 skins

items.title: Among Galaxies
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
When you travel space you find the oddest of life forms! In this skin pack you will also find some bizarre space creatures. Show your love of space by using one of these skins.

- 15 skins
- By: The Lucky Petals

items.title: One Block Lucky Block
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Take part in an exciting challenge... Try to survive with only one lucky block that regenerates infinitely! Will you be lucky enough?

- An infinitely self-regenerating lucky block!
- Lucky and unlucky events and loots!
- Mini-biomes to explore with secrets to discover!
- By Pixelusion

items.title: United Angels & Devils
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Angels and devils have come together to fight a common enemy. For the first time in the history of the universe, they are united! Choose between one of them and take part in the battle!

- 10 cool angel & devils skins
+ 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Friendly Bears
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Friendly bears are now on the streets! Have you ever met one? Well, guess what! You can be one of them and spread joy and fun all around the neighborhood.

- 30 friendly bears skins
+ 2 free skins!
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies

items.title: Lucky Block Castles
items.creator: Piki Studios
items.description:
The Queen and King of the Lucky Block Castle are on holiday, leaving you in charge to clean up all the Lucky blocks lying around the grounds. Grab your friends, one of the included skins, and play out all your medieval fanatasies!

- New mobs including Zombie boss, Nightmares, and Pumpkin TNT!
- 4 exciting skins perfect for your Castle Roleplaying
- Over 50 unique outcomes

items.title: Most Secure Mansion
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Live peacefully in a beautiful giant mansion protected by a lava lake and beacons all around! Explore the land outside for caves and hills and gather their loot!

-1 large mansion surrounded by a lava lake
-By inPixel

items.title: Noob Pro Hacker Rocket Edition
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
The Noob vs Pro vs Hacker Spaceship edition has arrived! Choose for yourself which one is your favorite by exploring these stunning spaceships.

-Many secrets to discover!
-To play alone or with others
-By inPixel and Evershapes

items.title: Cute Camo Yummies
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
These snacks are looking cute and ready for Minecrafting! Take your favorite foods and put them in adorable camo outfits. This unique skin pack is sure to turn heads!

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Unique theme with your favorite foods!
+ Collect all camo and food packs!

items.title: Cute in Camo
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Love camouflage but not uniforms? Look cute in these camo-themed outfits! Show off a bit of natural flare while looking stylish!

+ 12 custom duck skins for you to choose from!
+ Different adorable styles for everyone!
+ Collect all camo skin packs!

items.title: Trendy Teens
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Look adorable during any season with these trendy and colorful outfits! Wear a cute sweater, a bright hoodie, or ghost on your shirt! These unique skins will keep you looking cute!

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Unique outfits and a skin for everyone!
+ Collect all cute skin packs!

items.title: Mob Hoodies
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description:
These cute teen styles are inspired by some of the game's favorite mobs! Dress as a classic creeper, or wear a bee outfit!

- 11 skins
- 100% mob cuties

items.title: Slime Mobs
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Roleplay as any of these cute slimy mob skins. Join your friends to form an army of slimes, or just to play your favorite roleplay maps!

items.title: Ore Troopers
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Ore Troopers is a great skin pack to show everyone your vibrant ore trooper colors! 

- 13 skins included
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from 5 Frame Studios.

items.title: Bingo
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Team Workbench presents: Bingo! Challenge your friends in Minecraft Bingo. Play the single-player or multiplayer mode. Collect all items on your map by mining, crafting, and going to the Nether. PVP against the other teams in Bingo. Are you winning Bingo?

+ Single-player mode
+ Multiplayer mode
+ Lobby Parkour
+ Licensed by Team Workbench and published by BLOCKLAB Studios

items.title: The Crypt II
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Are you ready for another puzzle solving adventure? Continue the epic tale into yet another crypt.

-Over 5 hours of engaging gameplay.
-An evolving story with voice acting.
-A beautifully built world designed from the ground up.
-Custom music, textures, behaviors and models.
-Animated set pieces and custom boss fights.
-Created by HalfSlabLabs.

items.title: Noob vs Pro Lucky Block
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Want to become a Lucky Block expert? Time to test your luck. Start as a noob or a pro and become a true master of your game. Craft your own Lucky Blocks with more than 500 possible outcomes. Some can be amazingly good, some can be really bad. Which ones will you get?

> Craftable recipes!
> Epic traps & monsters!
> Perfect to role-play with friends!
> 1 free skin!

items.title: Bunker: Noob vs Pro vs Hacker
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
The zombies are attacking. Quick, jump in one of four massive bunkers and outsmart enemies with advanced traps and defenses! Then upgrade your bunker and become the safest player in the world!

+ 70 different AREAS to explore
+ New FUTURISTIC 3D models
+ NOOB, PRO, and HACKER bunker
+ Discover SECRET rooms 
+ 1 BONUS Bunker

! Play solo or roleplay with your squad

items.title: Among Spy Ninjas
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Spies and ninjas are among us! Sneaky and stealthy, these skins are perfect for role-playing a good old-fashioned mystery story. Impostors can’t hide from you, a true Japanese warrior with incredible legendary skills. Find them and win the game!

1 free skin included!

items.title: Dark Demons
items.creator: Vertexcubed
items.description:
Demons are back in black! Go all out against the SCP's and scare them away. Free the city from these so-called anime warriors, then go disappear into the shadows like a ninja and relax in your millionaire-worthy modern mansion. 

+ 10 luxury horror skins

items.title: Teens Free Spirit
items.creator: The Craft Stars
items.description:
Let your spirit run free! Role-play as teens with open minds and not a care in the world. Choose from 8 skin options and show off your worry-free self. Gear up in cool clothes with stars, wolves, or flowers and a free-thinking attitude.

1 free skin included!
